title: Harness-ops team config
description: Schema for harness-ops.yaml in a repository's convention home (default docs/conventions): the team layer of the harness-ops plugin's settings, and of harness-ops.local.yaml, the personal override, for registry_dir. Keys are read by /harness-ops:audit-install-state, /harness-ops:changelog, /harness-ops:known-issues and /harness-ops:setup and listed in plugins/harness-ops/README.md, Configuration. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

registry_dir.description: Project-relative directory holding the known-issues registry (registry.json). Beats the registry_dir userConfig option; the personal override beats it. Absolute, drive, UNC, traversal and escaping-symlink paths are invalid, and an invalid value resolves to the plugin data directory. Resolved by scripts/registry-dir.mjs.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example changelog); an entry beats this file's verification value.
